title: Moo Deng has entered her auntie era
summary: Thai PBS World reports a new calf born to Moo Deng’s brother Moo Toon and Moo Manao on November 4. Public introduction plans are still to be announced.

title: Fiona and Fritz take pumpkin crunching very seriously
summary: PEOPLE covers Cincinnati Zoo’s October 26 video of Fiona, Fritz, Bibi and Tucker enjoying pumpkins as enrichment. A seasonal snack, delivered with considerable enthusiasm.

title: Moo Deng’s fan mail gets an unusually good reply
summary: Thai PBS World reports that a young Brazilian fan received a reply carrying Moo Deng’s tail print. Celebrity correspondence has a new benchmark.

title: A desk safari with Maple and Kindia
summary: Toronto Zoo’s Maple page links to a Zoolife camera. Check that official page for current access, viewing windows and subscription terms before opening the stream.

title: Toronto Zoo introduces Maple by name
summary: The zoo’s August announcement introduced its Canadian-born pygmy hippo calf as Maple and described early life with mother Kindia. This is an archive milestone, not today’s viewing notice.

title: Haggis wins the keepers’ new-arrival award
summary: Wingham’s mammal team chose Haggis for its new-arrival honour in a keeper-written awards post. The story celebrates her personality and conservation role. It does not announce public viewing.

title: Poppy’s first year, according to her care team
summary: Metro Richmond Zoo marked Poppy’s first birthday with a care update and a look back at her first year. The December 2025 article also describes support for pygmy hippo conservation.

title: Toni’s Mulhouse chapter begins
summary: The local authority’s September 2025 article introduces Toni at Mulhouse. Keep this as relocation history and use the current official visitor page when planning a trip.

title: Maple meets Canada’s house-hippo lore
summary: Toronto Zoo, the CN Tower and MediaSmarts used the fictional Canadian house hippo for a media-literacy campaign. The zoo’s October 28 story highlights Maple while encouraging people to check the sources behind convincing online videos.
